remarks: The condo you've been waiting for at The Gables! This bright and spacious end unit offers one-level living with 3 bedrooms and 2.5 baths, and the convenience of an elevator from the garage that brings you just steps from your front door. The flexible open floor plan features two private balconies, a fully renovated chef's kitchen, new hardwood floors, and beautifully updated bathrooms. Additional highlights include a large walk-in pantry and a cedar closet for extra storage. Take in peaceful views of the meticulously maintained grounds, or stroll to the library, train, Binney Park, and the shops and restaurants in the heart of Old Greenwich village. Just minutes away, Greenwich Point offers beaches, trails, and water sports, while right at home you can unwind at the heated pool
